frozen_note: Committed and pushed before the first research run of numeric_v1. Nothing here changes afterwards. The previous research's protocol (research/preregistration.json) is unchanged.
strategy: M5 OB + M1 structure change + M1 FVG retest with a reaction candle (ob_m1_structure.mq5)
pass_verification: per optimization run: frames P-rows = XML rows = the manager log's 'total passes N' = 'N new records saved to cache' (this run's log section) = expected; every pass's inputs inside the grid; the merged lo+hi table holds each of the 18 tuples exactly once (KTD3, KTD4)

series.procedure: per fold, the train selection, or the defaults labelled fallback when no pass is eligible
series.identity: a series is named by its full parameter tuple; a candidate is never merged into a baseline because its variant matches (KTD7)

excluded_window_rule: August-September 2026 is not run by this study and is not a holdout (R23)
oos_label: outside the train window, not blind and not independent: all of December-July was seen in earlier research and pilots (R23)

selection.drawdown_metric: the tester's maximum equity drawdown of the train pass
selection.score: recovery factor (net profit / max equity DD in money) of eligible passes, 0 for ineligible passes
selection.smoothing: mean of the pass and its existing one-step neighbours on SwingStrengthM1 and StopBufferPoints (grid index steps) within the same StructureVariant
selection.tie_break: smallest distance to the defaults (index steps on ordinal axes, 1 for a different variant), then the lowest axis indices in the order StructureVariant, SwingStrengthM1, StopBufferPoints
selection.fallback: no eligible pass: status no_eligible_pass, the defaults (0, 3, 20) carried into the OOS month labelled fallback, never a selected or improved candidate (KTD6)
selection.uses: train data only; OOS results and robustness runs never change a choice

acceptance.positive_folds_rule: strict majority of the folds evaluated (3 of 5; 2 of 3 for group R)
acceptance.net_vs_baseline: the procedure's OOS net must be > 0 and exceed the OOS net of baseline_a AND of baseline_b (KTD10)
acceptance.risk_metric: loss limits on the daily equity records (eq_min) and MC on daily equity; the train selection uses the tester's maximum equity drawdown
acceptance.stability_label: of the final candidate's (or fallback's) grid neighbours (KTD8)

stability.neighbours: every one-step move on SwingStrengthM1 or StopBufferPoints inside the grid around the final candidate or fallback; the variant is categorical and is not a neighbour axis; a tuple equal to the candidate is never a neighbour
stability.criterion: share of neighbours with net > 0 >= 0.60: an acceptance criterion of the procedure; never read by selection (KTD8)

stats.dsr_trials_note: every evaluation of a configuration of this strategy on December-July: this research's 108 train passes (18 x 6 windows), the previous research's 12 train passes, 2 pilot runs and 4 stability perturbations. Excluded: the previous OOS runs, the August-September runs, the tick-coverage runs and the session probe (re-runs of counted configurations, or not strategy evaluations). Trials share data and overlapping configurations, so the effective number is lower; 126 overstates it, which makes the DSR stricter. Sensitivity: the 18 distinct configurations.
stats.var_sr: evaluate.trial_sharpe_variance over this research's six merged scored_grid.csv files: the per-window sample variance of the OnTester daily Sharpe (Custom column) over passes with trades, averaged over the six windows

drawdowns_reported: the tester's maximum equity and balance drawdown per run (maximum across folds)
the drawdown rebuilt from the daily equity records

groups.rule: all folds, group G (train includes generated ticks) and group R (train real ticks only) reported apart; acceptance also evaluated on group R for the report

session_minute.finding: quotes 01:00, trade session 01:01: SL/TP reached only in the quote-only minute execute from 01:01 (results/pilot/session_probe)
session_minute.sensitivity: research/mt5r/session_sensitivity.py: re-pricing of a fixed trade list at the first trigger tick of the quote-only minute; balance drawdown on the corrected timeline, closed trades only; later sizes, cap slots and signals are not re-simulated; reported for every OOS fold, the WFO aggregate and August-September; never used for a choice

reporting.pnl_exposure: all of December-July and August-September were seen in earlier research

behaviour_checks.criterion: zero conformance violations and checked cases > 0 for the checker's pivot_causality_r9 and sl_r18 rules in every run; pivot sets differ across N; logged stop-to-anchor distances equal the buffer (KTD11)

run_budget.robustness_single_runs: 3 to 5 (the static candidate or fallback plus 2-4 neighbours, KTD8)
run_budget.delivery_validation_runs: 4 on the delivered build plus at most 1 research-build twin (KTD13)

deliverables: at most a candidate .set (only when the final selection is 'selected') and a forward-test protocol on new data; a fallback .set otherwise; never a recommended .set (R24)
